---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature for StickForStats
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Use Case
Describe the problem this feature would solve or the use case it enables.

**Example:**
> As a researcher, I want to perform [statistical test] so that I can [analyze my data in this way].

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Statistical Background (if applicable)
If this is a statistical feature, provide:
- References to statistical literature
- Formulas or methods involved
- Existing implementations in other software (R, SPSS, etc.)

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request.

## Willingness to Contribute
- [ ] I would be willing to help implement this feature
- [ ] I can provide test data or validation cases
- [ ] I can help with documentation
